atoms.b: Subordinating conjunctions are linking words that combine an independent clause with ((++a_dependent an_independent any_type_of)) clause.

instruction.text: Is this an independent clause or a dependent clause?

end.text: The first part “Before you leave the house” cannot stand alone. So, it’s a dependent clause.
The second part “you should check the weather” can stand alone. It’s an independent clause.

atoms.sound: ssml: Subordinating conjunctions include. <break time='500ms'/> after.<break time='500ms'/> although. <break time='500ms'/> because.<break time='500ms'/> before. <break time='500ms'/> if. <break time='500ms'/> since.<break time='500ms'/> and when.

instruction.text: Select the subordinating conjunction in the sentence.

instruction.text: If you restructure the sentence, what would the correct way of doing so be?

feedback.correct: Remember: You don’t need a comma before a subordinate clause if it follows the main clause.

feedback.correct: If the subordinating clause is at the beginning of the sentence, be sure to add a comma at the end of the dependent clause!
